messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - auth-service.prod: unusual 401/403 spike from 18.216.45.0/24 hitting /v1/sessions. spike started ~2026-03-15T09:11Z. rate ~1200 r/s, unusual pattern. auto-created incident #INC-20260315-47
alice (oncall): Ack. I'm taking primary. starting triage now.
ben (sre): Pulling ELB/nginx access logs for 09:00-09:20Z, also starting live tail on auth proxies.
carla (sec): Security check: treat as potential credential-spray or token-replay. If we see tokens in logs, assume exposure.
dave (eng): Can we push a temporary WAF rule to throttle that /24 at edge? I can deploy a rule-scoped block.
alice (oncall): Please do. Throttle preferred over full block for now.
dave (eng): Pushing change now -> deploybot: edge-waf: apply rate-limit(100r/s) to ipset:18.216.45.0/24 (rule wr-8421).
incident-bot: deploybot: rule wr-8421 applied to prod-edge in 3s.
ben (sre): Initial logs: many 401s with user-agent "okhttp/3.12.1" and repeated session_create attempts. Some requests include JWT-looking strings in query param "token".
carla (sec): That suggests automated client replaying stolen tokens or a misconfigured forwarder exposing tokens. Any evidence of debug logs dumping tokens to external sinks?
erica (support): Two paying customers reported login failures ~09:12Z and one ticket mentions "we got an error, session invalid". CC: customers A & B. No public disclosure yet.
ben (sre): Searching log-forwarder configs... Found staging-forwarder rule in prod that had "debug: true" accidentally enabled and an s3 target set to externals-bucket-analytics. Need to confirm if prod also had it.
alice (oncall): If forwarder wrote prod debug logs to external bucket, that's a leak vector. Start immediate containment: revoke forwarder write creds and isolate bucket.
carla (sec): Agree. Initiate short-lived key rotation for any service accounts that could have pushed logs. Also collect an inventory of buckets written to in last 24h.
dave (eng): Command to rotate svc key for forwarder (example):
```bash
./infra/scripts/rotate-service-key.sh svc-log-forwarder --expire=15m --reason "suspect leak 2026-03-15"
```
I can run this after approvals.
alice (oncall): Run it. Ben, help with quick grep to confirm token samples and path. Carla, add legal if we confirm PII/exfil.
ben (sre): grep results: found ~120 lines in prod auth debug logs containing base64-like strings that match our token format. Samples copied to secure evidence bucket (audit-only). Path: s3://redwood-evidence/prod/2026-03-15/auth-token-samples.log
carla (sec): Good. I'll start impact assessment. Notify legal and privacy: legal@redwood.internal, privacy@redwood.internal.
erica (support): Draft customer note ready if needed. Suggested wording: "We detected unusual authentication traffic affecting session validation for a subset of customers. We're investigating and have applied mitigations; we'll follow up with details."
alice (oncall): Mitigations done so far: 1) rate-limit applied to 18.216.45.0/24 (wr-8421), 2) revoked forwarder write creds, 3) evidence copied to secure bucket, 4) scheduled key rotation for forwarder service account. Next: rotate any exposed service account keys, rotate tokens for customers affected if required, and run forensics.
dave (eng): Rotating KMS key for forwarder now. ETA ~7m. Will post events.
incident-bot: rotator: KMS key rotate initiated (key-id: kms-ff3b).
ben (sre): Confirmed no increase in error rates after rate-limit; 401 spike down to baseline. Still seeing replay attempts from other IPs — adding temporary denylist for those as we identify.
carla (sec): Action items: - Legal/Privacy looped - Full list of potentially exposed tokens (by user/customer) - Rotate service keys & KMS keys - Temporary creds rotation for affected customers (if tokens are user-scoped) - Post-incident customer comms plan
erica (support): I will queue the templated message and be ready to send once we have confirmed customer list.
alice (oncall): Logging timeline: started triage 3216549876, mitigations applied 3216549950, KMS rotate 3216550050. We'll keep this incident open until keys rotated and forensic audit completed.
carla (sec): I'll create a follow-up sec-ticket with required timeline and owners. Marking severity as S2 -> might escalate if PII found.
dave (eng): Quick note: hotfix to remove debug flag from forwarder config merged to main, deploying to prod as 3216550100.
incident-bot: deploybot: forwarder debug-flag removal deployed to prod (deploy id: 5621).
alice (oncall): Thanks all. Keep updates short here. If anyone escalates to customers/legal, ping this thread.
carla (sec): tagging for later: evidence retention path + checksum recorded.
ben (sre): I'll follow up with a concise postmortem draft after forensic window.
erica (support): Standby for customer list; will update within 30m. :white_check_mark:
